description: Lists the profiled app's SharedPreferences files (shared_prefs/*.xml, names without .xml) and the Room databases it registered with Lionscope.trackDatabase (status ok, or unsupported:closed / unsupported:driver). Needs a profiling session of an app with the Lionscope SDK 0.13.0+ and a server started with --allow-storage-read. Reads in the app's own process: nothing is copied off the device. "target" names the app link answering (device, app, link generation).
name: list_storage
title: List app storage
